text_block_list.text:
"As part of a TV program's special project,
Gentildonna and the others were set to participate
in a deserted island escape race..."
choice_data_list: (And as a pair, no less... I'm worried.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—The escape boat is at the summit.
However, to get it,
we need the key from the checkpoint...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
First, let's plan our route.
If we want to hit the checkpoints efficiently...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —From here, simply head straight toward the summit.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, we'll hit the checkpoints
while taking the shortest route to the summit."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like there's a path here.
You're not seriously planning to force your way through, are you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That was what I intended to say, you know?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It seems we've hit a dead end already.
What do you intend to do?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Does this look like a dead end to you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It does not appear that way to me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Ha!
(CLANK! CLANK! CLANK!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Wh...?! Through sheer force, she scaled the cliff...?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hah! Hah!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Kh!
A cliff like this is nothing, even for me...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Next is over toward that waterfall.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! Tree climbing this time?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Geez! ...Fine, bring it on!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
T-To think the final destination would be ruins...
Wasn't this supposed to be an uninhabited island?
(Rattle, rattle, rattle...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Hyah...! Who's there!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, what a sweet little voice.
—If you're frightened, you may wait right here.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The engine key is in the study. The boat is in the basement.
First, I shall head to the stud—...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Please wait.
Before you go, please lend me the key to the basement.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't have to push yourself.
You're scared, aren't you? Very scared.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However...
that is no reason to stop moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I won't let you keep pulling ahead.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ......Heh. Hehehehe.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Simple and straightforward—how truly adorable.

I welcomed Gentildonna and the others at the harbor
as they safely returned from the deserted island before anyone else.
choice_data_list: Still got plenty of energy to spare, huh...
Still got plenty of energy to spare, huh...

text_block_list.text:
I welcomed Gentildonna and the others at the harbor
as they safely returned from the deserted island before anyone else.
choice_data_list: Still got plenty of energy to spare, huh...
Still got plenty of energy to spare, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I thought I might enjoy myself a bit more...
What a truly regrettable shame.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“Ah. However—
in another sense, it was quite enjoyable.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ――...Is there something you wish to say?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Giggle... Oh dear. Look at how your fur is standing on end.
You poor thing...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"What are you so frightened of this time?
The wind? A shadow? Or perhaps..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Just leave me alone!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"That ground was a bit lacking in strength
to bring my strides to a halt, wasn't it?"
choice_data_list: Verxina's amazing for keeping up with her too...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
After all, she'll have no choice but to follow along.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To me. To Gentildonna.
No matter the time or place.
choice_data_list: Is that why you were able to charge forward without looking back?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Here. Please take whichever you like.
